tool_signatures.name: analyze_dataflow
tool_signatures.description: Track user input (request body, URL params, form data) flowing into dangerous sinks (SQL queries, eval, file operations, redirects). Detects injection vulnerabilities that regex rules miss by following variable assignments through code.

code.description: Code to analyze for tainted data flows

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Code to analyze for tainted data flows

tool_signatures.name: audit_mcp_config
tool_signatures.description: Scan MCP configuration files (.claude/settings.json, .cursor/mcp.json, .vscode/mcp.json) for security issues: malicious hooks (CVE-2025-59536), suspicious MCP servers, overly permissive tool access, and shell injection patterns. Use this to verify MCP configurations are safe before use.

tool_signatures.name: check_command
tool_signatures.description: Analyze a shell command for security risks before execution. Returns allow/ask/deny verdict with blast radius, safer alternatives, and context-aware risk assessment. Detects: destructive ops, git history rewrites, secret exposure, data exfiltration, deploy triggers, privilege escalation, database drops.

tool_signatures.name: check_dependencies
tool_signatures.description: Check npm, PyPI, or Go packages for known security vulnerabilities (CVEs) using the OSV database. Use this before adding new dependencies or to audit existing ones.

packages.description: List of packages to check: [{name, version, ecosystem}]

format.description: Output format: markdown (human) or json (machine-readable for agents)

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format: markdown (human) or json (machine-readable for agents)

parameters.name: packages
parameters.description: List of packages to check: [{name, version, ecosystem}]

tool_signatures.name: check_package_health
tool_signatures.description: Check npm packages for typosquat risk, maintenance status, adoption metrics, and deprecation. Use this before adding new dependencies to catch suspicious or risky packages.

format.description: Output format: markdown (human) or json (machine-readable for agents)

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format: markdown (human) or json (machine-readable for agents)

tool_signatures.name: check_project
tool_signatures.description: Scan multiple files for security vulnerabilities and generate a project-wide security report with a security score. Use this for comprehensive security audits.

files.description: List of files to scan: [{path, content}]

format.description: Output format: markdown (human) or json (machine-readable for agents)

parameters.name: files
parameters.description: List of files to scan: [{path, content}]

parameters.description: Output format: markdown (human) or json (machine-readable for agents)

tool_signatures.name: export_sarif
tool_signatures.description: Scan a directory and export results in SARIF v2.1.0 format for CI/CD integration (GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps). Returns JSON string.

tool_signatures.name: generate_policy
tool_signatures.description: Auto-detect project stack (Next.js, Supabase, Stripe, Clerk, Prisma, etc.) and generate tailored security policies. Outputs ready-to-use CSP headers, CORS configuration, Supabase RLS policies, rate limiting rules, and security headers based on detected frameworks.

tool_signatures.name: get_security_docs
tool_signatures.description: Get security best practices and remediation guidance for a specific topic, framework, or vulnerability type. Covers OWASP Top 10, framework-specific hardening (Next.js, Supabase, Stripe), and secure coding patterns. Returns actionable guidance with code examples.

tool_signatures.name: policy_check
tool_signatures.description: Check project against compliance policies defined in .guardviberc. Use this in CI/CD pipelines to enforce security gates, or before releases to verify compliance requirements are met. Validates custom framework requirements, severity thresholds, required controls, and risk exceptions. Returns pass/fail status with detailed findings per control.

tool_signatures.name: review_pr
tool_signatures.description: Review a pull request for security issues. Scans only changed lines (diff-only mode) and produces output for GitHub Check Runs, PR comments, or inline annotations. Supports severity gating to block PRs.

format.description: Output: markdown (PR comment), json (structured), annotations (GitHub Check Runs)

diff_only.description: Only report findings in changed lines (true) or all findings in changed files (false)

fail_on.description: Block PR if findings at this severity or above exist

parameters.name: diff_only
parameters.description: Only report findings in changed lines (true) or all findings in changed files (false)

parameters.name: fail_on
parameters.description: Block PR if findings at this severity or above exist

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output: markdown (PR comment), json (structured), annotations (GitHub Check Runs)

tool_signatures.name: scan_changed_files
tool_signatures.description: Scan only files that have changed since a given git ref (branch, commit, or HEAD~N). Ideal for PR checks, pre-push hooks, and incremental CI. Diff-aware by default: returns only findings on newly-added lines (set diff_aware:false for whole changed files).

diff_aware.description: Report only newly-introduced findings on added lines (true, default) vs. all findings in changed files (false)

parameters.name: diff_aware
parameters.description: Report only newly-introduced findings on added lines (true, default) vs. all findings in changed files (false)

tool_signatures.name: scan_config_change
tool_signatures.description: Compare before/after versions of a config file to detect security downgrades: CORS relaxation, CSP weakening, HSTS removal, debug mode, cookie flag changes, TLS disabling, new hardcoded secrets, removed security headers.

tool_signatures.name: scan_dependencies
tool_signatures.description: Parse a lockfile or manifest (package.json, package-lock.json, requirements.txt, go.mod) and check all dependencies for known CVEs via the OSV database. Reads the file directly. Use this after installing dependencies, during CI, or when auditing existing projects for vulnerable packages.

format.description: Output format: markdown (human) or json (machine-readable for agents)

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format: markdown (human) or json (machine-readable for agents)

tool_signatures.name: scan_host_config
tool_signatures.description: Scan host environment for AI security issues: API base URL hijacking (CVE-2026-21852), credential exposure in shell profiles, .env file leaks, and environment variable sniffing. Checks .env files at project scope; add scope=host to also check shell profiles and global AI configs.

scope.description: Scan scope: project (.env files only), host (+ shell profiles, global configs), full (+ home dir)

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Scan scope: project (.env files only), host (+ shell profiles, global configs), full (+ home dir)

tool_signatures.name: scan_secrets
tool_signatures.description: Scan files and directories for leaked secrets, API keys, tokens, and credentials. Detects high-entropy strings, known API key patterns (AWS, Stripe, OpenAI, GitHub, Supabase), exposed .env files, and missing .gitignore coverage. Returns findings with exact line numbers and remediation steps.

tool_signatures.name: scan_staged
tool_signatures.description: Scan git-staged files for security vulnerabilities before committing. Run this before every commit to catch issues early. No input needed — automatically reads staged files. Diff-aware by default: reports only issues on newly-staged lines (set diff_aware:false for whole staged files).

format.description: Output format: markdown (human) or json (machine-readable for agents)

diff_aware.description: Report only findings on newly-staged lines (true, default) vs. all lines in staged files (false)

parameters.description: Report only findings on newly-staged lines (true, default) vs. all lines in staged files (false)

tool_signatures.name: security_stats
tool_signatures.description: Show cumulative security statistics, grade trend, and vulnerability fix progress for this project. Use this to demonstrate the value of GuardVibe security scanning over time. Data is stored locally in .guardvibe/stats.json.
